working_definition: Author cell type 'transmedullary neuron Tm3a' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult head, 615 cells): Tm3 subtype a; authors' term FBbt:00003791 transmedullary neuron Tm3.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary narrow field neuron that terminates in lobula layers 1 and 4 with bleb-like terminal arborizations; fine arborizations in medulla layers M1, M4, M5; receives input from L1, L5 and Mi1 and outputs to T4 neurons.

justification: FBbt has no Tm3a term. Tm3b exists (FBbt:00110071) but as a direct child of transmedullary neuron, not of Tm3; Tm3 is the authors' own term and the correct parent of subtype a.
recommendation: Broad match to Tm3; no Tm3a term in FBbt.
